rows.quote: Summary statistics for T2D were obtained from the IEU Open GWAS database (ebi-a-GCST006867), based on a large meta-analysis including 62,892 T2D cases and 596,424 controls of European ancestry (10).
rows.coder_note: Step 3, rules B and C4, third case: the accession ebi-a-GCST006867 is listed by no dictionary row by prefix, range or identifier, and the cited reference (10), Xue et al. 2018, doi 10.1038/s41467-018-04951-w, is the source of no dictionary row; the counts 62,892 cases and 596,424 controls equal no row's.

rows.quote: Summary statistics for inflammatory cytokines were obtained from a protein quantitative trait locus GWAS dataset reported by Zhao et al. (GCST90274758–GCST90274848), which included 91 inflammatory cytokines measured in 14,824 individuals of European ancestry (9).
rows.reference_quote: Zhao JH, Stacey D, Eriksson N, Macdonald-Dunlop E, Hedman ÅK, Kalnapenkis A, et al. Genetics of circulating inflammatory proteins identifies drivers of immune-mediated disease risk and therapeutic targets. Nat Immunol. (2023) 24:1540–51. doi: 10.1038/s41590-023-01588-w
rows.coder_note: Step 2, rule C5. The sentence attributes the dataset to Zhao et al., reference (9), whose DOI 10.1038/s41590-023-01588-w is the source identifier of exactly one dictionary row; the sentence's 14,824 individuals and 91 proteins equal that row's. The accession range GCST90274758-GCST90274848 is listed by no row (C4, third case), which under C5 identifies no other row and is not a conflict.
